invariants.statement: NodeJoiningOperationLedgerFormationReadiness alone latches or bypasses the join barrier. Startup-authority owners supply validated evidence and the current release verdict but do not mutate joiner-local barrier state.
Unavailable authority or an incomplete local cache/transport intersection is indeterminate and cannot authorize bypass; persistent indeterminacy reaches the existing retryable timeout.
Bypass requires an available authority plus either an authoritative canonical population below the target replica count or a locally proven established ready-candidate floor at or above that target.
Candidate and pre-ready counts engage the barrier only when the target ready replica floor does not already exist. Later join waves on an established control plane use ordinary join readiness.

An exact authorized handoff whose immutable cohort contains this joiner latches engagement despite stale local candidate evidence, but release still requires the current global startup-authority verdict. A handoff excluding this joiner grants it no authority.
For an engaged barrier, a current ready release verdict succeeds even at the timeout boundary; timeout applies only while the current verdict remains not ready.

rules.reason: Cold-cohort or exact self-handoff evidence first latches the barrier; the separate current startup-authority verdict then authorizes release before timeout handling.
The existing global startup-authority verdict is the sole release predicate for an already latched barrier.
A genuinely cold cohort or exact self-capturing handoff latches without independently authorizing release.
Elapsed discovery time cannot bypass newly observed engagement evidence.
Engagement at the liveness boundary fails closed while the release verdict remains not ready.
Once latched, later observation churn cannot reopen ordinary join readiness.
The discovery deadline is not a release authority for an engaged barrier.
The unchanged timeout remains the liveness bound for a latched barrier whose release verdict is not ready.
Missing or incomplete evidence cannot classify the cohort.
Elapsed discovery time does not convert indeterminate evidence into a negative fact.
Persistent indeterminacy fails closed through the existing retryable timeout.
The fixed discovery window still permits a genuine cold cohort to arrive.
A current positive observation proves either an infeasible cold cohort or an already-established ready replica floor.
Positive bypass evidence remains authoritative; timeout is reserved for indeterminate or engaged observations.
